description: This Java source file defines the GlobalEventRegistry class, which manages deserialization strategies for Event subclasses from JSON objects and headers within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It implements singleton pattern, registry customization, and type resolution logic.

classes.name: GlobalEventRegistry
classes.description: Singleton class managing deserialization strategies for Event subclasses, extending AbstractGlobalJsonParsableRegistry and implementing EventRegistry.

classes.name: EventParsingStrategyFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating deserialization strategies for Event annotated with JsonParsableEvent.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of GlobalEventRegistry.
